title: all-hands
text:
all-hands

Maya: ok that's a wrap! thanks y'all — loved the demo :raised_hands:
Devon: toasting with my cold brew :coffee: congrats team
Ravi: toaster trombone solo incoming 🥁 (no real trombone, just my voice)
Jules: *slow clap* :clap::clap:
Max: confetti cannons engaged :confetti_ball:
Priya: who brought snacks? I'm calling dibs on leftovers
Lina: marshmallow s'mores in the kitchen — help yourselves :chocolate_bar:
ops-bot: Meeting recording available: https://redwood.example.com/rec/2809876543
Maya: afterparty on #random at 4:30? low-key kazoo optional :kazoo:
Devon: i'll bring kazoo. also dog photos please
Ravi: attaching dog photo (not actually an attachment in Slack chat) :dog:
Jules: poll: best celebratory snack? 1) Pizza 2) Donuts 3) S'mores 4) Nothing, I'm on a cleanse
Priya: Voted s'mores :raised_hands:
Max: donuts for me :doughnut:
Lina: cleanse can wait
Maya: also kudos to @Ravi and @Priya for the Q&A handling :trophy:
Devon: :sparkles: @Maya you hosted like an absolute pro
Ravi: thanks! team effort
ops-bot: Reminder: office fridge cleanout tomorrow 10am — last chance to rescue snacks
Jules: i'll rescue the vegan muffins :rocket:
Max: GIF: https://giphy.com/gifs/celebrate-xyz
Priya: :heart:
Devon: leaving applause — :applause: :applause:
Maya: goodnight everyone, see you in the afterparty :wave:
